notes.title: 《零怨 The curse of the dead》日常更新
notes.content:
《零怨制作组》日常更新维护

*********************************
此次更新如下：

1.更新大楼后厅里莫名其妙的出现黑色面片BUG
2.删除地下室“配件库”多余物品“信物-香囊”此物品导致的无法正常加载场景BUG
3.更新防沉迷持续时间，更改了类型，这次更加合理了
4.修复由于测试导致进入地下室玩家获得所有道具的BUG

notes.title: 《零怨 The curse of the deab》V 0.2.0version update
notes.content:
更新日志20-3-24

V 0.2.0版本更新——

·大楼场景重新设计，加入第四层场景
·第二章场景更新，加入新死亡动画
·更新游戏按键。按键现在已经被更改了，具体游戏中按“TAB”按键查看
·新AI系统，加入信纸。

------------------------------------------------------

让大家久等了！！
为了让大家玩到好的游戏，制作组们费尽心思去摸索新玩法，在这期间制作组认为现有章节内容非常少，而且有很多问题，所以在讨论之后决定在现有的章节上下功夫去重新制作第二章节游戏场景，虽然咱也比不上那些高大上的游戏场景，但是对比之前应该是个进步，我们也在学习也在不断摸索，日后会考虑在现有的场景继续修改内容，使他变得更好更出色。

在接下来制作组会看看现在的0.2.0版本有没有问题，如果没有问题通过制作组的考核，那么制作组会去制作第三章场景，也希望各位购买了这款游戏并且你认为还可以的朋友麻烦帮忙点个赞，哪怕你打个“支持”也是对我们的支持！！

如果你认为这款游戏不适合你，那很抱歉我们没有令你满意，对不起！！你可以申请退款的，我们也希望能再次与你相见！！
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Update log 20-3-24            

V 0.2.0 version update——            
·Redesign the building scene and add the fourth floor scene            
·Chapter 2 scene update, adding new death animation            
·Update game buttons. The key has been changed now. In the specific game, press the "tab" key to view            
·New AI system, add stationery.            
------------------------------------          
Let everyone wait for a long time!!            
In order to let everyone play a good game, the production team made great efforts to explore new playing methods. During this period, the production team thought that the content of the existing chapters was very few, and there were many problems, so after discussion, the production team decided to work hard on the existing chapters to remake the game scene of the second chapter. Although we can't compare with those big game scenes, it should be a step forward before comparison Step, we are also learning and exploring. In the future, we will consider to continue to modify the content in the existing scene to make it better and better.            

Next, the production team will see if there is any problem with the current version of 0.2.0. If there is no problem passing the assessment of the production team, then the production team will go to make the scene in Chapter 3. I hope that you can buy this game and your friends who think it's OK can ask for a comment!            

If you think this game is not suitable for you, I'm sorry we didn't satisfy you, I'm sorry!! You can apply for a refund, and we hope to see you again!!
